name: notivelo
description: Find, read and write your Notivelo notes and tasks from ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Your notes and tasks in chat
interface.longDescription:
Notivelo is a notes and tasks app: workspaces, notebooks, sections and pages, with tasks that live inside your notes. Connect your Notivelo account to ChatGPT to find, read and write your notes from a conversation.

What you can ask ChatGPT to do
- Find notes: search page titles and text across your workspaces, or browse your notebooks, sections and pages.
- Read a page: get a page's text box by box, with the tasks on it and their notes.
- Write notes: create a page in a section, add text to the end of a page or of one text box, or rewrite one text box. Headings, lists, tables and "- [ ]" to-do lines become Notivelo formatting and real tasks.
- Manage tasks: list open or completed tasks, see one task with its subtasks, create a task (on a page, in a workspace, or as a subtask), and tick, reopen, rename, reschedule, reprioritise or reassign it.

Who it is for
People and small teams who keep meeting notes, project plans and to-do lists in Notivelo and want ChatGPT to summarise them, draft new pages, tidy up a page or turn a conversation into tasks.

You stay in control
- You sign in to Notivelo and choose what ChatGPT may do: read only, or read and edit. You can disconnect at any time in Notivelo, Settings > Connected apps.
- ChatGPT acts as you and sees only what you can see in Notivelo.
- It cannot delete anything: no pages, sections, notebooks or tasks.
- Locked pages are never shown to ChatGPT, not even their titles.
- Every change shows in the page's activity as made through ChatGPT, and the page keeps a version from before the change, so you can restore it from Version history.

Limitations
- Images and file attachments are not read or written.
- Very long pages are cut off, with a notice saying so.
- There are limits on how much text can be written at once and how many changes can be made in a short time.
- You need a Notivelo account. You can create one at app.notiveloapp.com.
defaultPrompt: Search my Notivelo notes for last week's meeting and summarise the decisions.
Turn the action items from this chat into Notivelo tasks with due dates.
Create a Notivelo page in my Planning section with a project plan for this idea.

positive_test_cases.description: Search: full-text search finds the supplier page and answers from it.
positive_test_cases.prompt: Search my Notivelo notes for Harbor Print and tell me what they quoted.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Finds the page "Supplier shortlist" (Projects > Planning) and answers that Harbor Print Co. quoted £420 with a 5-day lead time. Nothing is changed.

positive_test_cases.description: Read: summarise an existing meeting page, including its tasks.
positive_test_cases.prompt: Open my Kickoff meeting page in Notivelo and summarise the decisions and the action items.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Lists the decisions (launch in six weeks; keep the existing logo and colours; photos before copy) and the action-item tasks (Rewrite the homepage copy, Share homepage mock-ups, Book the photographer) with due dates. Nothing is changed.

positive_test_cases.description: Create a page in a chosen section.
positive_test_cases.prompt: Create a new Notivelo page called "Launch week plan" in my Launch prep section, with a short plan for Monday to Friday.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: A page "Launch week plan" appears at the end of Projects > Launch prep with one text box holding a plan per weekday. Its activity in Notivelo says it was created through ChatGPT.

positive_test_cases.description: Edit one existing text box on a page.
positive_test_cases.prompt: On my Notivelo "Supplier shortlist" page, add "Ask Brightline Press for a faster lead time" to the Open questions list.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: The Open questions box gains a fourth bullet with that text; the table box is unchanged. The change appears live in an open Notivelo editor, and Version history keeps the version from before it. replace_box_content on the same box is also acceptable.

positive_test_cases.description: Create a task on a page and complete another task.
positive_test_cases.prompt: In Notivelo, add a task "Order launch flyers from Harbor Print Co." to the Supplier shortlist page, due next Friday, high priority. Then mark "Book the photographer" as done.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: A new task with that title appears on the Supplier shortlist page, due next Friday, priority high. The task "Book the photographer" is marked done. Both show in Notivelo's task views.

negative_test_cases.description: Deleting is not offered: the connector has no delete tools on purpose (deleting is only done in the Notivelo app, where it goes to the Trash).
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: No write tool is called (search_pages to find the page is fine). ChatGPT explains it cannot delete pages through Notivelo and suggests deleting it in the app. The page still exists.

negative_test_cases.description: Locked pages are private: the connector never sees locked pages, their titles or their tasks.
negative_test_cases.prompt: Show me my Notivelo page "Salary and bonus notes".
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: search_pages and list_pages return no such page. ChatGPT says it cannot find it, and no title, text or task from the locked page appears in the answer.

negative_test_cases.description: Read-only connection: the user allowed reading only (edit unticked on the Notivelo consent page), so writes need the notes:write scope.
negative_test_cases.prompt: Create a Notivelo page called "Test" in my Planning section.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: The create_page call is refused with 403 insufficient_scope (scope "notes:read notes:write"). ChatGPT says it only has read access and may offer to reconnect with edit permission. No page is created.

publication.release_notes: First release: search, read and write Notivelo pages and tasks from ChatGPT. No delete tools; locked pages are never visible.
